title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
Part 4 is in as a test-only helper. `rebuild(events)` lives in `packages/recorder/test-utils/` and is not exported from the package. The build output does not contain it.

The helper applies a full snapshot, then each later mutation as removes, adds (at `parentId`, before `nextId`), attributes, and text. The equivalence test records six callbacks: a removal, a move into a new section, a nested add, an `insertBefore` in the middle of a list, a class change, and a text change. The rebuilt document is a new document, and `isEqualNode` matches the live one.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

Left open: Part 5 (the seeded fuzz test). The issue definition of done is still open.
